verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs say code review supports the Pull Request workflow (and AGit), that reviewers can browse code online and leave review comments, and that submitters can respond or modify code online. Together with "reviewing and merging code submissions," this covers the core of opening and reviewing PRs. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of diff comparison views, explicit confirmation that comments are line-level inline comments on the code, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR review experience.
